title: API and Contract Testing in Python: pytest, Schemas and Contracts
concept: Test Rice Rocket's HTTP API the way production breaks it, with pytest and httpx: test cases derived from the OpenAPI contract, response schemas, status codes and error bodies, consumer-driven contracts, factories and fixtures that clean up, idempotency and retries, parallel runs without shared-state flakes, and reports that point at the cause. Challenges are Python programs graded in the code runner.
description: Test Rice Rocket's HTTP API the way production breaks it, with pytest and httpx: test cases derived from the OpenAPI contract, response schemas, status codes and error bodies, consumer-driven contracts, factories and fixtures that clean up, idempotency and retries, parallel runs without shared-state flakes, and reports that point at the cause. 8 lessons on one project, each applying the tool to a real production situation, with 1-2 graded challenges per lesson.

learningOutcomes.text: Derive API test cases and schema checks from the contract instead of from the happy path.
Test status codes, error bodies, idempotency and retries the way clients rely on them.
Catch breaking API changes with consumer-driven contract tests before deploy.
Keep the suite deterministic in CI: isolated test data, safe parallel runs and useful reports.

knownIssues: Challenges run Python with the standard library only; pytest, httpx and contract tooling appear in the lessons, the graded code uses small stand-ins.
